name: insights
description: What a program did when it ran, and what the editor is doing, with nothing to ask for: every run's statement coverage marked in the gutter of the file it ran (from any debug session that reports it — the tsval debugger does); on hover, what went through the code under the cursor across runs (values, how often nullish, their kinds; each branch's arms); hints, with quick fixes, where runs say a `?.` or `??` was never needed or a branch never taken; a profile saved under .silo/local/profiles/ (the editor saves one when a preview runs slow) announced with where its time went; and a monitor of the metrics plane (memory by realm, workspace fill, long frames, hub traffic, storage) in the status bar and a view of sparkline cards.

silo.evidence.minRuns.markdownDescription: How many runs must have reached a `?.`, `??` or branch since its code last changed before the editor suggests it could go (a `?.` never nullish, a branch never taken).

silo.evidence.minSeen.markdownDescription: How many values must have gone through a `?.` or `??` — or how many times a branch must have run — across those runs before the editor suggests it could go.

enumDescriptions: Statements, values and branches: everything a tsval run records.
Statements only: the cheapest, an increment each.
Nothing: previews run their code as written.
silo.evidence.previews.markdownDescription: How much of a preview's code the dev server instruments for runtime evidence. Wrappers run on the app's hot paths: scale it back if a preview's frame budget is tight. Applies to the next preview started.

silo.machine.markdownDescription: This machine's name in the runtime evidence kept in `.silo/` (each run records where it ran: this name, plus the browser, OS and cores it detects). Name each machine you work on, so timings compare like with like. Empty is `default`.
